narration:1:1760006001:0.text: As the horn sounds once more, Agumon and Brutus charge at each other.
narration:1:1760006001:0.source_cn: 随着号角再次响起，亚古兽和布鲁特斯碰撞在了一起

narration:2:1760006002:0.text: Brutus wields his massive sword, slashing with deadly precision and force.
narration:2:1760006002:0.source_cn: 布鲁特斯挥舞着沉重的巨刃，凌厉而精准地劈砍

narration:3:1760006003:0.text: Meanwhile, Agumon nimbly dodges attacks and spits Baby Flame at Taichi's command.
narration:3:1760006003:0.source_cn: 而亚古兽则在太一的指挥下，灵活地闪避、喷吐小型火焰

narration:4:1760006004:0.text: Agumon holds on through several rounds despite the odds.
narration:4:1760006004:0.source_cn: 几个回合下来，尽管艰难，但亚古兽始终坚持着

say:6:1760006005:0.text: Taichi, Agumon… You can do it!

say:8:1760006006:0.text: You notice Taichi has been carefully studying the terrain around him. It seems like he is waiting for something...
say:8:1760006006:0.source_cn: 你注意到，太一始终在观察着周围的地势。他似乎在等待着什么……
say:8:1760006006:0.male: You notice Taichi has been carefully studying the terrain around him. It seems like he is waiting for something...
say:8:1760006006:0.female: You notice Taichi has been carefully studying the terrain around him. It seems like he is waiting for something...

say:11:1760006007:0.text: Now, Agumon! Curl up into a ball, just like the time we fought Yukidarumon!
say:11:1760006007:0.source_cn: 就是现在！亚古兽，就像对付雪人兽那样，卷成球状吧！

say:12:1760006008:1.text: Take this! I'll show you our loop shot!
say:12:1760006008:1.source_cn: 就让你见识一下，我们的S型射门神踢！

say:13:1760006009:1.text: To everyone's surprise, Taichi delivers a forceful kick to the ball-shaped Agumon, sending him flying over Brutus!
say:13:1760006009:1.source_cn: 在众人惊讶的目光中，太一竟用力地将卷成球状的亚古兽踢向...

say:14:1760006010:1.text: Agumon then stretches out his body, latches onto Brutus' back, and opens his mouth wide.
say:14:1760006010:1.source_cn: 这时，亚古兽伸展身体，用力抓住了布鲁特斯的后背，张大嘴巴——

say:18:1760006012:0.text: Brutus swings his sword backward, trying to shake Agumon off and put out the fire.
say:18:1760006012:0.source_cn: 布鲁特斯将巨剑向后挥去，将亚古兽逼退的同时，快速将火焰扇去。

say:19:1760006013:0.text: Just as Taichi is about to give another command, applause suddenly breaks out. Brutus lowers his sword and begins clapping with a smile.
say:19:1760006013:0.source_cn: 太一打算继续指挥亚古兽战斗时，却听到一阵掌声。布鲁特斯...

say:21:1760006014:0.text: That move caught me off guard. If that flame had been stronger, I would've lost. Trust me, you'll get better with time.
say:21:1760006014:0.source_cn: 出其不意的一招。只要亚古兽的火焰足够强大，我就会落败。...

say:22:1760006015:0.text: Impressive, Agumon and Taichi. In terms of strategy, you've defeated me.
say:22:1760006015:0.source_cn: 干得漂亮，亚古兽、太一。你们的战术胜过了我。

say:23:1760006016:1.text: Congratulations on passing the Trial of Courage!
say:23:1760006016:1.source_cn: 我宣布，你们通过了勇气试炼！
